## GPT-2 Tokenizer

The GPT-2 tokenizer is a [byte-pair encoding](https://github.com/openai/BPE) tokenizer with a vocabulary of 50,257 tokens. It was released with [OpenAI's GPT-2 model in February 2019](https://cdn.openai.com/better-language-models/language_models_are_unsupervised_multitask_learners.pdf).

This specific tokenizer was retrained on the [WikiText-103](https://www.scs.manchester.ac.uk/donald/projects.html) dataset with a byte-level algorithm so that every possible input can be decoded (contrarily to the original tokenizer).

It is recommended to use this tokenizer to fine-tune the OpenAI GPT-2 model for downstream tasks.

## Usage

```python
from transformers import GPT2Tokenizer

tokenizer = GPT2Tokenizer.from_pretrained('gpt2')
```
